The exact 40-row Comparator roster is a nested evidence/admission screen, not the universe boundary. The selected row is the unconditional full-support irrationality theorem with a completed Bertrand/CRT divisor-block certificate pipeline.
candidate_value_selection.anti_underclaim: Classical status does not demote a direct theorem with a visible hard mechanism merely because a more restrictive row is broader in support-class language.

candidate_value_selection.reversal_condition: Only a newly committed, source-checked row with strictly stronger direct consequence, genuinely deeper independent mechanism, equal-or-better evidence certainty, and no larger hidden-hypothesis risk can replace this selection.
